investigatorTips.description: A young man matching the missing person's general build was seen near the riverfront food stall shortly after sunset, wearing a blue hoodie and carrying a black backpack.
A commuter reported a person with a blue hoodie and white sneakers heading toward the east platform, but said the clothing could have been similar to other riders.
The family friend recalled the subject had a small scar above the right eyebrow and often wore black jeans with a grey-stripe backpack.

cctvSightings.description: A person wearing a blue hoodie and black jeans is visible on a pedestrian bridge, moving quickly toward the western exit. The footage does not confirm identity and is limited by lighting and angle.
A lone rider carrying a black backpack is seen near the bus stand. The description is consistent with the family-reported clothing but cannot establish identity with certainty.

matchingEvidence: Blue hoodie matches the family-provided clothing description.
Black jeans are consistent with the witness and CCTV descriptions.
conflictingEvidence: No direct identifier confirms the person is the missing person.
leads.uncertainty: Identity is not established by the available descriptions.
leads.recommendedNextAction: Verify the sighting details with the witness and request the bridge camera footage for a more complete time window.

matchingEvidence: The scar description and backpack style align with the family profile.
The bus stand footage shows a black backpack consistent with the reported bag.
conflictingEvidence: The witness account does not include a verified identifier or direct visual comparison.
